column1: # DigiFrame custom 16 MB layout — 4 MB OTA app slots (room for future features).
# Build with PartitionScheme=custom so this file is used.
# NOTE: growing the app slots moves the ffat data partition
# layout onto a device wipes LittleFS (GIFs/config) once — the default GIF pack
# re-seeds and config falls back to defaults on the next boot.
